{{Conjecture|legends}}
{{Quote|In an attempt to stop these illegal activities, an agent was dispatched to Etsero's den, ''The Red Lisken''. He never reported in and it is believed he may have met with foul play at Etsero's hands.|Airen Cracken, ''Wanted by Cracken''|<ref name="WbC">[[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|''Wanted by Cracken'']]</ref>}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''individual''' served as an agent of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="WbC" /> In [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]],<ref name="Date">[[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|''Wanted by Cracken'']] is dated to three [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. Since ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates that conflict to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the placement of the sourcebook therefore translates to [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]].</ref> the agent was dispatched to [[The Red Lisken]], a [[Casino/Legends|casino]] on<ref name="WbC" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Journal11">{{JournalCite|11|Alien Encounters (article series)}}</ref> [[Adner]]; however, the agent never reported in with his superiors and was suspected to have been dealt with by [[Etsero]], the establishment's owner.<ref name="WbC" />
